entities.summary: Walter (Wali) Jones is an American former professional basketball player. He was a 6-foot-2-inch (1.88 m), 180-pound (82 kg) guard. He was point guard on the 1966-1967 Philadelphia 76ers team that is considered one of the greatest teams in NBA history. He has been honored for his longstanding community work in West Philadelphia.
